name: Awei PC-1 Mini Stereo In-Ear Earphone
description:
Product Description:

Enhance your audio experience with the Awei PC-1 Wired In-ear Headphones Earphones Headset with MIC. This versatile device combines the functionality of in-ear, noise-isolating earphones with a convenient cellphone headset, ensuring you never miss a beat or a call. Ideal for extended music sessions, the Awei PC-1 delivers clear sound quality in any environment.

Key Features:

In-line microphone for hands-free calls
Music playback control and song selection
Noise isolation for uninterrupted listening
Compatible with a wide range of devices including computers, MP4 players, iPhones, iPads, HTC, Samsung, and Android mobile phones
Warranty:
Enjoy peace of mind with our 6-month official warranty, ensuring your satisfaction with every purchase
